race.comment: SLIPSAIN (10) was ridden with more aggression last time out and responded by finishing third at Eagle Farm over the mile. Stepping up to Saturday company but down on 54kgs he gets his chance. LUTON HOO (1) made it two wins from four this prep when she closed too strongly for her BM68 midweek opposition over this course and distance recently. Good miler who comes into calculations again with the help of Youngberry's claim. BLUEPINOT (2) has been pretty disappointing of late but is worth one more chance as this is a big step back in grade. THINKING GOLD (5) did a good job at the Sunshine Coast when first-up for a new stable a fortnight ago. Open to plenty of improvement.
